viz_gaps.reason: This worked-example figure (WE4) plots G(7; -9) and H(x; 0) joined by a segment, and additionally carries a floating slope label, "m_GH = 3", positioned beside the segment rather than at either endpoint. coordinate_plot's spec only supports text via points[].label, i.e. a label anchored to a specific (x, y) point — it has no field for a free-floating text annotation attached to a segment/line. Drawing the two points and the segment is easy, but the gradient label would either have to be silently dropped (not allowed — it's a labelled element the figure shows) or faked as an invisible extra 'point' carrying that text, which misrepresents the data.
viz_gaps.needed_kind: coordinate_plot (or a segment-focused kind) that supports a text/value label attached to a segment or line itself, independent of its endpoint points

meter.record: uv run meter_run.py record --book g10-math --stage S2-S4,S8 --run <runId>
meter.by_stage: uv run meter_run.py summary --book g10-math --by phase
meter.by_lesson: uv run meter_run.py summary --book g10-math --by lesson
meter.note: Phase titles start with their stage (S2, S3, S4, S8), so `--by phase` is the per-stage cost; every label carries the lesson slug (S3:blind:<slug>:1), so `--by lesson` is the per-lesson cost.
